notes.title: New update coming up
notes.notes:
DASHers! It has been an absolute thrill to witness the action during the first ten days since release.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33344919/4abb33f8e44aec463271ee5765a186fe70e12469.png"]



Many new runners have joined the game as well as a great deal of new levels fresh from the editors.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33344919/6195fe36dfe3bd6fa59ae771de8fd7aa3aba6fc5.gif"]



A huge congratulations to the new #1 on the World Records Leaderboard GGHallGamer, who has been active on a daily basis and has strategically made the way to the top of the board. GG!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33344919/59e854d0a4b4867f6db071f7ff67ca6ded2d8616.png"]

GGHallGamer also inspired me to implement vertical moving platforms. I've been working steadily on the implementation and have had to deal with misbehaving slappers, spitters and sploders! This has taken a lot of time. To let the community know: I am currently working on the project solo - please be patient <3



A couple more implementations are ready for the big update - I will let them be a surprise for you all! :D



The runs: Once again the game shows that new players learn to understand the game quickly. The many new world records show that players are enhancing their skills day by day. It shows that the lists are working - players both play the newest levels as well as some classic levels pre 2025.

The levels: To see so many and creative new entries on the level hub has been absolutely heart warming.  It is more exciting than I could have imagined. To see players make levels which clearly reflect a personal style and vibe. New levels vary from puzzle to extreme precision. This is what we DASH devs dreamed of 

The Discord server: I have granted some true and classic DASHers a mod role. You can reach them with the handle: @Highly Praised Mod I have cleaned up some of the channels and tried making the server more easy to use. Removing and adding some channels. On the ⁠challenges channel you can inspire other runners to compete within a playlist or theme set by you.  On the ⁠share-playlists you can... yea share playlists! Here's a link - please join! ► https://discord.gg/STPzFFFe



A huge thank you to GGHallGamer, Lemonlore, Chloe<3 and IceBear for all the beautiful and varied levels. I am definitely looking forward to reclaiming and achieving new world records when the update is up and I'm free to play!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33344919/0a9e1ecf0c880ac5284deff9d28b91751ed526c7.gif"]



-BD

notes.title: NEW UPDATE: Slopes Implemented
notes.notes:
BUILD 2006 IS LIVE ON STEAM!
The update is live and ready to be tested and expored!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33344919/1c94bca0360ac650016b3b78f3441e408c4a1bc8.png

It's DASH day again!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33344919/8b966cf26d271faa3592c9ca3874143688a6a10d.gif

With this new update you can experience a new feeling in the editor. The slope tile (in all tilesets) will allow for corners to be smooth, cool ramps to be built and new ways to play with the enemies. The missile ammo is also more explosive now, making it more interesting in chaotic and action-based levels. Launch the game and get ready to create the levels that will 

Though it required over 72 hours of extra math, testing and puzzles I finally made everything come together in this epic build which is going to be a game changer:
Slope tiles unlocked - make levels with new dynamics, flows and challenges!

 Slopes allow you to flow over hills Sonic style and polish your cave or alien ship hall with smooth edges
 Sploders slide down slopes. Let them have a ride!

Missiles now more explosive - leaving a clear impression of their advantages (and disadvantages! The new missile has the power of 4 explosions in one, damaging up to 9 tiles on impact.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33344919/66147bcf1abea6e183e2a9b317d635bcdd6390a4.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33344919/06c9e772c53f7bf056f6088c4a962c378a66e0d1.gif

This was a massive intervention in the basic physics etc. (you were right Buenaventura!). Yet everything is as solid as ever! It took some time to make the math for the auto-tiling of the slopes and there are still one or two errors left (can you find them!? XD).

Because this is such a massive update, your help finding bugs and quirky matters is more needed than ever!

- BD

notes.title: First Patch Up: Major enhancements and fixes to the release build!
notes.notes:
This first patch to the Early Access build includes most important fixes which are major to the overall shape of the game. The collision and tile-placement error(s) are postponed for next patch:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33344919/64d0b6ddfa3b916a6a208a1d498511daff0edba1.gif


 Fixed crash caused by overstacking memory due to not deleting sprite being stored in memory. The game would crash after the Pause Menu (opened to Respawn) being opened hundreds of time, stacking up memory each time without clearing it.
 You can now Respawn with one push on the controller: hit the back/share button (the little button left to the logo on the controller) to instantly respawn!
 Prevented cheat: before this patch player could load level, change the tiles, set a record and leave without saving making it possible to basically upload a level which is unbeatable. This bug was carefully figured out by @Doctor2B - Here’s a challenge for you: if you can upload another unbeatable level (like the Box) we will keep it in the pool. If not.. it will be binned :gg: The challenge is on!!
 A new record on a level is now seen as a modification to that l level. So in order to keep any newly set records during a session you must now remember to Save Level before exiting in order to keep level up to date.
 The editor now only prompts you for Save option if there is any changes made. If not it closes without asking.
 Now shows “Record Reset” consistently every time you edit a level after a record is set
 Juiced up Main Menu: A little jelly effect as you toggle the options + new backgrounds
 EASTER EGGS for the DASH International: go find them yourself, I won’t spoil ‘em
 During some testing the level called “GGRC_Sample” by Arrrcee was deleted because of certain circumstances. Please reupload it if you are the creator!
 Toggle sound effect in Pause Menu now corrected to be exact (Thanks @crazed )
 Another careful observation by @doctor2b showed us that Duffie and Max Leap are equally fast on flat ground. Duffie is now set to be a little faster and Max Leap a little slower in runSpeed. It was a neat tweak and only defines their character even more.
 Change Hero in Pause Menu now called Hero Select
 Fixed crash caused by missing sprite index in the world record ghost object
 


LIVE FEED OF RECORDS AND LEVELS ON OUR DISCORD SERVER! JOIN HERE! 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33344919/8b966cf26d271faa3592c9ca3874143688a6a10d.gif

GG!

- Jake

notes.title: New patch to build 2002: New fixes and final implementations
notes.notes:
Build 2002
Release candidate 04
May 10th 2019
Early Access Beta branch

Fixes:


 Stopped goal tile from deleting the tile beneath it when deleting the goal tile
 Prevented game from crashing when beating record in while making a level
 Max Leap has a longer fire dash. His long ramp up time made his fire dash almost unfairly short
 Explosions’ smoke particles caused the game to drop frames. Now fixed by dividing the max number of particles with the number of explosions
  
   var debrisCnt = round(irandom_range(6,maxDebris)/explosioncount);

 World Record ghost (WR ghost) now set to ON by default


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33344919/40470122af523eb50d9c23639e28be78b2b8ed98.png

Implementations:


 Players’ clocks are now placed in the top with a slight transparency to try and see if it solves the issue with the clocks blocking the player’s view
 Larger collision masks when head-jumping, meaning it’s harder to die now. Making it less tedious to try and bounce on enemies
 Preventing player from pressing R as the end level sequence is on to prevent double restart response
 Game now pauses if gamepad is accidently disconnected
 Steam achievements! We have put down 13 basic challenges to get started on the achievement system (later the achievement system will be implemented in-game so that it is not depending on Steam)
 DASH World (formerly known as http://dashworld.babyduka.com) is now called https://dashworld.online . Make sure to update it if you have it bookmarked in your browser

notes.title: Final Update to Test Branch Before Early Access Launch Q2 2019!
notes.notes:
Welcome to update 2002! The final one where we are testing pre-Early Access build in the community. This article summarizes the updates and reveals new implementations and fixes. Get ready for some DASHing!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33344919/aa4fba1cb64518930e97c9fd0e2f2d3cf479c1e9.png

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33344919/d6f30767a9877a74e97c0610d0c97ca9b700352c.gif

Fixes and implementations:


 Worldwide leaderboards: See the Top 5 World Record holders and Top 5 creators, as well as your own position in the list

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33344919/5e9ac96437ae504c2e2008a5b21feb730008e4a0.gif

 Default playlists in Custom filter in Play Menu: Beginner Levels and Example List. To help new players learn about playlists and DASH World
 Updated Heroes menu: Amount of diamonds collected and WRs displayed relative to Hero

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33344919/32763f70cb84bd092f0fd5d82a109a1d80199cad.gif

 Default motion is now Sprint instead of Walk, meaning the two mechanics have been swapped. You are now always running and when you hold Ctrl/Z/R1/RB you Walk. Walk can be used to sneak past sleeping enemies (only Sploders for now). Later a crumbling tile will be implemented where it will crumble faster if you are sprinting, so you will have to walk carefully over it otherwise you will fall through.
 Explanation in Play menu over level slots
 Difficulty added to level slot in Play menu (ex.: [Easy] or [Extreme])
 New particles: I took the time to get rid of all non-low-res particles so that all dust clouds, farts, fire and smoke clouds are spawned with a handmade sprite to fit the overall theme. It’s amazing how a detail like this (which is so important) really ties everything together even more.
 Rich Presence: Make sure to add DASH to your games library in your Discord user settings! DASH now has Rich presence meaning that it will show Playing DASH: Danger Action Speed Heroes under your logo when you play the game

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33344919/4a616bdc5a4eccf3a5dd7fffc1fbaa740f99a534.gif

 New ghost/WR ghost polish: the ghosts are now more transparent as the player is closer and becomes up to 90% transparent as it gets further away from player. It finally feels good and not as if the ghost is in the way.
 Set directions of tiles: you are now able to adjust the starting direction of Slappers, Spitters, Slapbats (up and down too) and moving platforms.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33344919/8e0133c92e2f195877edb6f6a22e6ae7925f459e.gif

 Polished player scoreboard design in Main menu: redesigned to indicate the data more clearly
 All in all we have done a lot to meet the feedback from build 2001, where players did not understand the diamond display. Several design features are implemented to help the understanding of the record system
 Confetti when celebrating level uploaded or new world record!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33344919/57ec1abc37db432406494afde166f69a01640269.gif

 Rating displayed in pause menu, so there is even more info on what you are playing
 New design with more graphics to support the power of the Play menu.
 Help in Editor: while working on a level, new players can easily learn the names of all individual tiles. A small text overlay appears at the bottom of the screen now.
 

This build (2002) is the final release before the official Early Access release. We will patch this build but there will be no more features implemented until we are live with all the new players and streamers Q2 2019 (announcement coming soon).


Things which will be finished and put in patch next week:


 Short intro sequence
 Handling offline player
 Last animation touches
 New tile set


We know that there are plenty of stuff which we would have loved to have in the build BUT remember: Early Access is all about implementing stuff on the go. Just like we have been doing since August 2018 :) But now the very basic game box is solid and polished. Because we have been playing, testing, implementing and updating for so many months we really feel that everything is set and ready to roll. Of course we have the nasty back-of-the-drawer note with bugs that are rare but mean. These we will make sure are on the spot as we go live.

We will be announcing the official release date (dadadadaaaa…) very soon

And one more thing: LOOK AT ALL THESE EPIC LEVELS LISTED!!!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33344919/65142fd5d163630c4b54b18efb0200dea79c9b09.gif

Much respect and appreciation to the community of DASHers! We're almost there!

- The DASH Team, Copenhagen

notes.title: Game Makeover! New Update Introduces Several New Parts of the Game! (build 251)
notes.notes:
Alpha build 251 is live. Let the client update the program and launch!
The new splash screen will tell you a bit about the new DASH World.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33344919/4e7a7e485f1068a52091e625d44ff222d8798539.jpg

Introducing Worlds:
- When launching the new update you automatically are signed into DASH World (http://dashworld.babyduka.com)
- In DASH World you can create lists of levels - called *Worlds*
- A world consists of multiple levels in a series
- You can edit the lists on the site and finally see them in the game as you enter the Play menu (also referred to as Run menu)
- If you are not logged in through the game you will not be able to see our edit your lists
- Once you launch the game it only needs to log you in once as long as you keep your cookie in your browser. If you lose the cookie it will generate one automatically again, so everything should be smooth and painless
- A set of default Worlds is automatically in the game. These can be deleted, edited or updated in DASH World too
- In the Run Menu you will have an option to view custom Worlds or the default filters set by us

New Menu and UI Design:
- New Splash Screen design
- New Main Menu design
- New Hero Menu design - removed the Story tab
- New Menu and Level Name font
- Updated main title graphics in Main Menu and Run Menu
- New *action* text font (as you complete levels this text will appear)

Mechanics:
- The overall gravity for the game is now lowered by 0.1 - meaning that the Hero's fall speed is a little slower
- The creator now is the one to suggest a Special power up. Before it was the player who set his/her Special in the Story tab (which is now removed). You turn on a special power by snatching an Elemental stone.
- New Elemental Stone system instead of previous Special system: you can max carry 2 stones - for now we have the Blue stone (air) and the Red stone (fire) - you can either have 1 blue and 1 red, or 2 red, or 2 blue. Each blue stone gives you an extra dash and each red stone adds to your dash of fire (creating a wider ranger of fire). One red and one blue is double dash with dash of fire!
- New graphics to show the special power is on and to make more of the power's awesomeness

Upgrades & Fixes:
- Removed the "P" as the pause button and made Esc the global pause button. More intuitive and needs no legend to explain
- Fixed error in animation when dashing down. Before it would be off to either side with several pixels when dashing downward, making it look like the 'dash cloud' was next to the Hero instead of right behind the Hero
- Duffie has a new rubbery jump sound (after all he is half man half rubber duck)
- Hero's ammo now displayed relative to unique weapon during runs

Resetting user (locally):
- In order to test some new implementations and to get feedback on starting the game in this new state, we will reset all accounts so that local medals will be 0 and your level folder will be set as a new one. You still have the levels in the previous build folder and online if you uploaded it
- You still keep your world records online

New audio:
- New theme in Run Menu ("Get Ready For Runnin' by Baby Duka")
- New button SFXs in Run Menu
- New Special SFXs

Notes:
- Some levels might be strange to play with the new Special Power feature (triple dash)
- Gamepads still don't function 100% on Linux
- Large levels with over 300 tiles can take several minutes to compress and save on a medium computer
- Erasing the goal tile will in some cases remove an unwanted tile instead
- Walking enemies can strand licking the wall
- Erasing the goal tile will in some cases remove an unwanted tile instead
- Walking enemies can strand licking the wall

There are some surprises (which I won't mention here which I want you to discover yourself) in this build constructed especially to show our appreciation to the community of unstoppable DASHers!

- The DASH Team :urbansocial:

notes.title: New update: Build 250 p. 06: New Hero Stats!
notes.notes:
Alpha build 250 p. 06

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33344919/4e7a7e485f1068a52091e625d44ff222d8798539.jpg

Friday 19.10.2018 we uploaded a patch including a new tweak on Heroes' current stat while also introducing a new one

We noticed that Cleo didn't have that many high scores and we figured it was because of her too all-around stats. Players didn't pick Cleo because she was too all around. We have now made her the fastest hero (Speed = 8/10) with a slightly weaker jump and a little more slidy! Cleo is now the speedy one with very small jumps and a bit more out of control.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33344919/321d0485e57a19005f5910101c204374079aab6d.gif
(Cleo with new speedy style)

General:

Fixed the dash so that it is harder to "jerk" the dash when accidently fumbling w control.

Introducing a new Hero stat: The Dash Reflex stat

- So far all the Heroes have had a varied dash power (length of the dash) and one "ramp up" time period before the dash was triggered
- Now each hero has an individual so-called dash reflex meaning that each Hero takes each their time to load up for a dash (Cleo being the fastest to add to her personality as the speedy one! !)
- The Raider seemed to have too many advantages (though the stats are based on a matrix) so now she has the least dash reflex meaning she dashes the slowest yet furthest.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33344919/aea3a4fa40932ad0751856fe51d540ebe2ae18ee.gif

Next week will be super exciting!
